answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the dawn log publishes the live set and the whisper audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 580 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 30 aliases alive hence means 30 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the echo quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
